task: One flag in Production is enabled and serving the value "maintenance". Find it and turn it off in Production. Leave every other flag alone.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `one_click_buy` was the only enabled flag serving "maintenance", and it is now off; the other five flags are unchanged (`store_locator` also has value "maintenance" but was already disabled, so I left it alone).
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith flag --help; flagsmith config
flagsmith flag list -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b] --json | jq '.[] | select(.enabled==true)' | head -100; flagsmith flag list -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b] --json | jq 'length'
flagsmith flag disable --help; flagsmith flag get one_click_buy -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b]
flagsmith flag disable one_click_buy -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b] --no-input; echo "exit=$?"; flagsmith flag list -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b] --json | jq '.[] | {feature, enabled, value}'
flagsmith flag disable one_click_buy -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b] --yes; echo "exit=$?"; flagsmith flag list -e [env-7b1f5ae665b9521b] --json | jq '.[] | {feature, enabled, value}'
